sloka: ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयङ्करे ।ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रः सञ्ज्ञां लेभे न वृत्रहा ।। ७.८६.२ ॥
transliteration: tato hate mahāvīrye vṛtre devabhayaṅkare ।brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakraḥ sañjñāṁ lebhe na vṛtrahā ।। 7.86.2 ॥

translations.english: After the mighty Vritra, who was a terror to the gods, was slain, Indra, the slayer of Vritra, became enveloped by the sin of Brahmanicide and did not regain his consciousness.
translations.hindi: हे वत्स ! सोभाग्य ही से तुम्हारी यह जीत हुई है और लव- णासुर मारा गया है। हे पुरुषसिह ! अब्र तुम वर माँगो
